profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java, Spring Boot, Javascript, Perl, Typescript, HTML, CSS
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at Cengage Group, I contributed to the development, testing, and maintenance of web applications and services that support the company's online learning platforms and products. I have over two years of experience in this role, having started as an Associate Software Engineer and progressed to my most recent position.

I used Perl, JavaScript, HTML, Java, Spring Boot, and Typescript to create and enhance user interfaces, functionalities, performance, and security of the WebAssign platform, which serves millions of students and educators. I collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet the needs and expectations of our customers and stakeholders. I am also AWS certified, having obtained the Cloud Practitioner and Solutions Architect - Associate certifications.

I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from California State Polytechnic University-Pomona and an Associate's degree in Mandarin Chinese from Defense Language Institute Foreign Language Center. I am passionate about learning new technologies and languages, and I enjoy solving complex problems and challenges. My military experience has taught me the importance of personal responsibility, teamwork, and communication, which I apply to my software development career. My goal is to continue to grow my skills and knowledge as a Software Engineer and to contribute to the success and innovation of meaningful products.

positions.description: Worked closely with associates to produce intelligence reports from raw data. Prepared and gave presentations to assist teammates in staying up-to-date on current events and important information. Assisted in training new Language Analysts in proper translations of technical terminology, proper report formatting, as we as how to navigate and integrate information from various databases. Monitored and controlled electronic computer and peripheral electronic data processing equipment while maintaining close communications with teammates to ensure mission success and safety.
